_about: The six styles of workflow 2 (atlas/ALIEN.md 8.2), as the ideas and script stages read them. ids match _shell/styles.json. buildable: the engine draws its whole spine today and film.py has its builder; a style that is not buildable is never offered, so nothing is faked.

styles.name: Reading Wipe Before/After
styles.look: Raw footage and one sentence: the request, as an editor would type it. A leaning caret reads the sentence, and the caret is the seam of the before/after: everything it has passed is already the delivered edit, in the same framing. The sentence is spent as it is read. Then the delivered short, untouched; others like it in quick cuts; the whole delivery counted on one sheet.
styles.hook: Frame 0 is the raw footage, the sentence and the caret. By 0.5 s the frame is changing behind the caret.
styles.close: The count locks. Then the keyword, drawn in static that only reads while it moves.
styles.needs: a ledger run with many delivered shorts, its raw source on disk, and one short that opens on a continuous take of 7 s or more
styles.cta: a keyword of 4 to 7 letters that only exists in motion (A1), on its own for about 3 s before the end card

styles.name: It Edits Itself
styles.look: The reel pulls back onto its own real timeline; a request is typed; a clip moves; the film changes.
styles.needs: the film's own EDL as layers, and a real re-render of the change

styles.name: One Clip, Three Films
styles.look: The same 6 s three times, three real edits from three requests.
styles.needs: three real results on one clip, recorded through the product

styles.name: Silent Film, Hidden Word
styles.look: No voice. An effects film at 17-28 cuts per 10 s with one long breath, ending on the pause-proof keyword.
styles.needs: weave and glyph junctions between real exports; a sound plan without a bed

styles.name: Exploded
styles.look: Time stops and the frame comes apart into its real layers with real values.

styles.name: Did You Notice
styles.look: A plain talk to lens; the room changes six times in blinks; rewind, replay.
styles.needs: matte, clean plate and blink times (class B)
